customer_drafts.subject: Update on your Bulldog tee

Hi Tauhid,

Thanks for reaching out about a Bulldog tee in size S. We’re sorry, but size S is currently unavailable. We’re confirming whether we can restock it, so I can’t yet give you a delivery date. We do have the same tee in sizes M, L, and XL. Would any of those work for you, or would you prefer to wait while we confirm the size-S option?

Best,
Campus Customs
